items.q: And the piano player was named, a name like Beryl, Beryl, somethin' like that, Eddie Beryls, somethin' like that

ctx.x: And the piano player was named, a name like Beryl, Beryl, somethin' like that, Eddie Beryls, somethin' like that, a little semi-classical pianist that could play jazz. It wasn't considered a jazz band like Skinny Johnson and all those guys -
